#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Throwaway local execution recorder; JSON report verdicts remain authoritative."""
import argparse, datetime, json, os, pathlib, shlex, signal, subprocess, sys, time
p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--out', required=True)
p.add_argument('--timeout', required=True, type=int)
p.add_argument('command', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
a = p.parse_args()
cmd = a.command[1:] if a.command[:1] == ['--'] else a.command
out = pathlib.Path(a.out)
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
begin = time.monotonic()
with (out/'stdout.log').open('wb') as stdout, (out/'stderr.log').open('wb') as stderr:
    child = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, start_new_session=True)
    timed_out = False
    try:
        code = child.wait(timeout=a.timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        try:
            child.wait(timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            child.wait()
        code = 124
record = dict(schema='chaoscontrol.local-command-observation.v1', cwd=os.getcwd(), command=cmd,
              display_command=shlex.join(cmd), timeout_seconds=a.timeout,
              operational_timeout=timed_out, exit_code=code, started=start,
              finished=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-begin,
              non_claim='Exit status is not a guest-bug verdict or a report-verdict decision.')
record['artifacts'] = []
for name in ('stdout.log','stderr.log'):
    path = out/name
    digest = subprocess.run(['b3sum','--no-names',str(path)], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    record['artifacts'].append(dict(path=str(path), digest='blake3:'+digest, bytes=path.stat().st_size))
(out/'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
sys.exit(code)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Observe the unchanged native contract through its retained official CLI."""
import json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
root, out, recorder = map(pathlib.Path, sys.argv[1:])
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
audit = json.loads((root/'dogfood-results/production-readiness-closure-20261015/cairn-native-source-audit.json').read_text())
rows = []
for specification in audit['commands_for_parent']:
    name = specification['id']
    command = specification.get('direct_cli_argv', specification['argv'])
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(recorder),'--out',str(out/name),'--timeout','300','--',*command],cwd=root)
    observation = json.loads((out/name/'execution.json').read_text())
    text = (out/name/'stdout.log').read_text()
    row = dict(id=name,observation=observation,report_path=str(out/name/'stdout.log'))
    if name == 'policy_projection_freshness':
        row['report_passed'] = text.strip() == 'policy fresh: cairn-policy/generated/cairn-policy.json'
    else:
        try:
            report = json.loads(text)
            row['report'] = report
            row['report_passed'] = isinstance(report,dict) and all(report.get(key)==expected for key,expected in specification.get('require_json',{}).items())
            if name == 'native_release_readiness':
                checks = report.get('checks')
                row['report_passed'] = row['report_passed'] and isinstance(checks,list) and bool(checks) and all(check.get('passed') is True for check in checks) and all(any(check.get('name')==required and check.get('passed') is True and check.get('skipped') is not True for check in checks) for required in ('mcp_agent_smoke','preserves_corpus_freshness'))
        except (ValueError,TypeError,AttributeError) as error:
            row['report_passed'] = False
            row['parse_error'] = str(error)
    row['passed'] = result.returncode==0 and not observation['operational_timeout'] and row['report_passed']
    rows.append(row)
    (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(schema='chaoscontrol.continuation-native-observations.v1',all_required_passed=all(row['passed'] for row in rows),results=rows,non_claim='No copied producer fixtures, policy migration, check optionality change, skipped check, or exit-only verdict.'),indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(all_required_passed=all(row['passed'] for row in rows),checks=len(rows))))
raise SystemExit(0 if all(row['passed'] for row in rows) else 1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Throwaway actual CLI/contract positive and rejecting-path observations."""
import json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile
root, out, executable = map(pathlib.Path, sys.argv[1:])
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
rows = []
def observe(name, argv, expected, diagnostic=None):
    result = subprocess.run([str(value) for value in argv], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
    (out/(name+'.stdout.log')).write_text(result.stdout)
    (out/(name+'.stderr.log')).write_text(result.stderr)
    passed = result.returncode == expected and (diagnostic is None or diagnostic in result.stderr)
    rows.append(dict(id=name, command=[str(value) for value in argv], exit_code=result.returncode, expected_exit_code=expected, required_diagnostic=diagnostic, passed=passed))
    return result
observe('registry-admitted', [executable, root], 0)
exported = subprocess.run(['nickel','export',str(root/'contracts/evidence/registry.ncl')], cwd=root, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
registry = json.loads(exported.stdout)
for family in ['portable-snapshot-descriptor','campaign-progress','simulator-runtime-records','execution-traces','fault-outcomes','campaign-reports']:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='registry-missing-', dir=out) as directory:
        temporary = pathlib.Path(directory)
        contracts = temporary/'contracts/evidence'
        contracts.mkdir(parents=True)
        altered = dict(registry, families=[row for row in registry['families'] if row['id'] != family])
        assert len(altered['families'])+1 == len(registry['families'])
        (contracts/'registry.json').write_text(json.dumps(altered))
        (contracts/'registry.ncl').write_text('import "./registry.json"\n')
        observe('registry-reject-'+family, [executable, temporary], 1, 'missing required family ids')
observe('process-empty-and-boundaries', ['nickel','export',root/'contracts/evidence/fixtures/valid/process-instances.valid.ncl'], 0)
for case in ['duplicate','token','cardinality']:
    observe('process-reject-'+case, ['nickel','export',root/('contracts/evidence/fixtures/invalid/process-instances.'+case+'.invalid.ncl')], 1)
summary = dict(schema='chaoscontrol.continuation-actual-cli-contract-smokes.v1',all_passed=all(row['passed'] for row in rows), cases=rows, non_claim='Actual local CLI/contract paths only; not KVM, historical parity, supervisor attestation, or release readiness.')
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if summary['all_passed'] else 1)
